nodes.description: admin / pendingAdmin address used for privileged access control checks across BToken, BController and BirdCore.
_notEntered reentrancy guard boolean flipped by the nonReentrant modifier.
accountTokens mapping of bToken balances, mutated by mint/redeem/transfer/seize.
totalBorrows accumulator updated in accrueInterest, borrowFresh and repayBorrowFresh.
totalReserves of the underlying held by the market.
implementation address used as the delegatecall target by BirdCore.
birdAccrued mapping of unclaimed BRID+ per user, written during distribution.
birdOracle external contract used by getUserRating to derive collateral factors.
liquidateBorrowFresh: repays the borrower via repayBorrowFresh and then seizes collateral, including internal seize and external seize calls.
seizeInternal: moves accountTokens from borrower to liquidator after bController.seizeAllowed.
redeemFresh: computes redeem amounts, checks cash, calls doTransferOut then writes storage.
borrowFresh: updates borrow balances and calls doTransferOut to the borrower.
transferBirdPlus: external BRID+ token transfer to a user above the claim threshold.
refreshBirdSpeeds: public speed recalculation gated by a tx.origin == msg.sender check.
getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal: iterates account assets, adds oracle-derived rating to collateral factor and multiplies fixed-point values.
_acceptAdmin: transfers admin rights to pendingAdmin after an identity check.
_setPendingImplementation / _acceptImplementation: changes the delegatecall target of BirdCore.
BirdCore payable fallback that delegatecalls msg.data into the implementation address.
transferTokens: allowance and balance bookkeeping, then bController.transferVerify hook.
accrueInterest: block-number-based interest accrual writing accrualBlockNumber, borrowIndex, totalBorrows and totalReserves.
doTransferOut: underlying transfer out (native or ERC-20), reverting on failure.
mintFresh: doTransferIn then exchange-rate based token accounting.
delegatecall of msg.data to the implementation address inside the BirdCore fallback.
External value transfer (doTransferOut) executed before/around storage updates in redeem, borrow, repay and reserve flows.
External call to the BRID+ token contract (balanceOf/transfer) inside transferBirdPlus.
Fixed-point mul/div and add/sub operations in accrueInterest, exchange rates and seize token calculation.
msg.sender controls caller identity for hooks, admin checks and msg.sender-based seize accounting.
tx.origin compared against msg.sender in refreshBirdSpeeds.
borrower address parameter of liquidateBorrowFresh.
repayAmount parameter of liquidateBorrowFresh bounding the repaid debt.
bTokenCollateral market parameter of liquidateBorrowFresh whose seize/exchangeRate functions are called.
RedeemLocalVars memory struct holding exchangeRate, redeemTokens, redeemAmount and new supply/balance values.
seizeTokens computed by liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens and consumed by seizeInternal.
deltaIndex / supplierDelta values computed during BRID+ distribution.

edges.reason: The implementation state variable supplies the target address for the delegatecall; whoever controls implementation controls arbitrary code execution in BirdCore's storage context.
The payable fallback unconditionally forwards msg.data to the delegatecall, so any caller can reach the unsafe delegatecall.
msg.sender reaches the fallback and thus the delegatecall without any caller validation.
_setImplementation / _setPendingImplementation rely only on msg.sender == admin checks; a compromised or mis-set admin directly changes the execution target.
_acceptAdmin finalizes the admin transfer based solely on msg.sender == pendingAdmin identity.
refreshBirdSpeeds authorizes callers with msg.sender == tx.origin, a phishing/contract-mediated bypass of the intended EOA restriction.
deltaIndex-derived supplier/borrower deltas flow into the BRID+ distribution routine that decides the transferred amount.
transferBirdPlus performs an external BRID+ balanceOf/transfer call before returning the residual accrual, giving an untrusted token control flow during distribution.
The external token call occurs while birdAccrued is being updated, enabling reentrant state observation if the token is malicious.
redeemFresh performs doTransferOut (external value/token transfer) and only afterwards writes totalSupply and accountTokens, the classic checks-effects-interactions inversion.
borrowFresh calls doTransferOut to the borrower before writing accountBorrows and totalBorrows.
liquidateBorrowFresh invokes seizeInternal (or an external seize on another bToken) after repaying, creating cross-contract callback surface.
The liquidation path reaches doTransferOut through repayBorrowFresh while the nonReentrant guard is shared across the same call frame.
The _notEntered guard gates redeemFresh and the other nonReentrant entry points, mitigating (but not removing) the callback risk on the transfer-out path.
The borrower parameter flows into the liquidity calculation that decides whether the liquidation is permitted.
repayAmount determines the debt repaid and therefore the seize amount computed via the controller.
bTokenCollateral drives external exchangeRateStored/balanceOf/seize calls whose results feed the seizure logic.
The RedeemLocalVars struct carries exchange rate and new balance values into the storage writes of redeemFresh.
seizeTokens derived from liquidationIncentive and oracle prices is applied directly to accountTokens in seizeInternal.
accrueInterest relies on mul/add/subUInt style fixed-point arithmetic whose results are written to totalBorrows/totalReserves/borrowIndex.
Collateral factor plus oracle rating and multiplier composition in getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal is arithmetic-sensitive and uses a custom add().
birdOracle.getRatingByAddress feeds the user rating added to the collateral factor, making the oracle an external dependency of the liquidity check.
seize() uses msg.sender (never a parameter) as the seizerToken, so caller identity is a security-critical input to seizeInternal.
The user-supplied repayAmount reaches the external transfer-out path during repayment.
Accrued BRID+ balances are read and rewritten around the external transfer inside transferBirdPlus.

normalization_plan.reason: The borrower parameter is only meaningful as an argument of liquidateBorrowFresh and should be folded into that core function node.
repayAmount is a local argument of liquidateBorrowFresh and is merged into the function node.
bTokenCollateral is consumed exclusively by liquidateBorrowFresh and is merged into it.
RedeemLocalVars holds transient values of redeemFresh and is merged into that core function node.
seizeTokens is an intermediate value consumed by seizeInternal and is merged into it.
deltaIndex-derived accrual values are computed for transferBirdPlus and are merged into it.
